dogecoin.text: To all $DOGE fanboys who're still busy licking Elon's butthole: When $BTC tanks, every other alt, including $DOGE tanks. Guess they don't teach u that over at #TickTock Crypto Kindergarten?

Dear $DOGE fans, I still see some of you cheering @elonmusk's tweets that are meant to tank $BTC. Elon cannot be ignorant to the fact that tanking $BTC will tank $DOGE as well. Stop supporting the SOB! What we need is a united front against him. Get him out of Crypto completely!

@Tytheflyguy617 @elonmusk He doesn't care about ANY Crypto. He knows full well that when he tanks $BTC, all other alts, including $DOGE will tank even more. I just wish more $DOGE holders understand this.
